Name: Duolinguo Companions and Outfit
Author: EndlessPathB103
Description:
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]An Unsubscribeable Companion | 无法取消订阅的伙伴[/size][/color][/b]
Receive an urgent green letter containing the mysterious Duo's Jade Flute. Play it to summon your responsible (and slightly obsessive) study partner!你会收到一封紧急的绿色信件，内含神秘的多儿的翡翠笛子。吹响它即可召唤你负责任（且略带强迫症）的学习伙伴！[/list][list]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Global Language Easter Eggs | 全球化语言彩蛋[/b][/size][/color]
Duo isn't silent! It will randomly remind you in 9 different languages, adding an international surprise to your farm life.多儿可不是哑巴！它会随机用9种不同语言提醒你，为农场生活增添一份意外的国际色彩。[list]
[*][code]"Hiciste tu leccion hoy?"[/code]
 (Spanish) | [code]“今天学习了吗？”[/code] (Chinese Pinyin)[*][code]"Vamos, tu puedes hacerlo!"[/code] (Spanish) | [code]“加油，你能做到！”[/code] (Chinese Pinyin)
[*][code]"Nicht prokrastinieren!"[/code] (German) | [code]“别偷懒！”[/code] (Chinese Pinyin)
[*][code]"Saa, ganbatte!"[/code] (Japanese) | [code]“来吧，加油！”[/code] (Chinese Pinyin)
[/list][*][color=#0000ff][size=4][b]Exclusive Items & Fashion | 专属物品与时尚[/b][/size][/color]
